name: Northam Platinum Holdings Limited
summary: Northam Platinum Holdings Limited, through its subsidiary, Northam Platinum Limited, engages in the production and sale of platinum group metals. The company explores for platinum, palladium, rhodium, gold, iridium, ruthenium, nickel, copper, and chrome deposits. It holds interests in the Booysendal mine located on the eastern limb of the Bushveld complex; the Zondereinde mine located in the northern end of the western limb of the Bushveld complex; and the Eland mine located in the south-eastern portion of the western limb of the Bushveld complex. The company also offers recovery services. Northam Platinum Holdings Limited was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Johannesburg, South Africa.
